name: Rubber & Smoke
summary: Rubber & Smoke is a free-to-play multiplayer drifting game that runs directly in the web browser. Players drift a tuned JDM-style car around the Smoke Valley Raceway with handling that sits between arcade and simulation: holding the drift angle, linking transitions and getting close to the walls builds chains and multipliers. Rooms with a shareable code let up to five players drift together, made for streamers playing with their community. Timed rounds are scored on the server, and logged-in players (Twitch login) earn XP and levels and appear on a public leaderboard. No download or installation required.
